## TBDub Teacher (30-step) - best-quality lip-sync
1. One-time: run DubSync\setup_tbdub_teacher.bat (separate Python 3.10 runtime + ~15 GB weights).
2. video_path = ONE shot (or a DubSync face crop) with ONE visible speaker.
3. audio_path = Hindi VOCALS for exactly that clip.
4. Output: .mp4 = viewable with audio, .mkv = lossless for DubSync paste-back.

Defaults = official Teacher: 30 steps, ref_cfg 2.0, audio_cfg 6.0.
memory_mode: resident (24 GB+ fastest) | cpu_offload (~19.5 GB GPU + ~22 GB RAM) | stream (experimental, for 16 GB).
TBDub works at 25 fps internally; the node converts and returns your exact source frame count/fps.
Multi-shot film: run  dubsync.py render --engine tbdub  instead.
